notes: Own open Main; hand/own Set; requires at least one face-up Attack monster on either field. No cost or target. At resolution change all current face-up Attack monsters on both fields to face-up Defense simultaneously; face-down/Defense untouched, manual markers unchanged. Pass-only one-link scope; no mixed Chain/negate/modifiers/immunity/replacement or FLIP/SEGOC expansion. Imported history stays pending.
